interview.narrativePedigree.conditions.description: Subheading above protocol-authored condition names. Only this generic heading is translated, not the names of conditions.

interview.narrativePedigree.diseaseStatu.description: One entry in a locale-formatted screen-reader list of conditions and statuses. condition is an authored condition name; status is an already localized clinical status label.

interview.narrativePedigree.familyPedigr.description: Snapshot title fallback used only when the protocol has no stage label. An authored stage label always takes precedence and stays unchanged.

interview.narrativePedigree.focusOn.description: Accessible action focusing the inheritance view on a person. name is entered research text or a localized relationship fallback; do not alter it.

interview.narrativePedigree.hasCondition.description: Plain-language legend meaning of the filled affected-status symbol: the person is recorded as having the condition.

interview.narrativePedigree.key.description: Heading for the symbol legend, shared by the on-screen condition panel and the printable snapshot document.

interview.narrativePedigree.mayCarry.description: Plain-language legend meaning of uncertain carrier status. Preserve the uncertainty and distinguish carrying from developing the condition.

interview.narrativePedigree.mayDevelop.description: Plain-language legend meaning of uncertain risk of developing the condition. Preserve the uncertainty and do not claim a diagnosis.

interview.narrativePedigree.notKnown.description: Plain-language legend meaning when genetic status is unknown or the protocol hides probabilistic status markers.

interview.narrativePedigree.obligateAffe.description: Clinical status label for a person inferred to be necessarily affected, including presymptomatic disease. This is stronger than an at-risk status.

interview.narrativePedigree.obligateCarr.description: Clinical status label for a person inferred to necessarily carry the inherited variant. It does not itself say that they have symptoms.

interview.narrativePedigree.resetZoom.description: Accessible action restoring default diagram magnification and recentering the scroll position.

interview.narrativePedigree.resizeKey.description: Accessible name for the splitter resizing the condition-legend panel beside the diagram.

interview.narrativePedigree.saveSnapshot.description: Action saving the current family tree, selected condition, focus and notation legend as a printable PNG image.

interview.narrativePedigree.selectCondit.defaultMessage: Select a condition to see who it affects.
interview.narrativePedigree.selectCondit.description: Instruction for choosing one condition to show its inheritance notation and enable focusing on a family member.

interview.narrativePedigree.showingAll.description: Live announcement when no single condition is selected and the interface shows all protocol conditions.

interview.narrativePedigree.showingAllFo.defaultMessage: Showing all conditions. Focused on {name}. Showing who contributes to their inheritance.
interview.narrativePedigree.showingAllFo.description: Whole live announcement for an all-conditions view with a focused person. name is entered text or a localized fallback; preserve the explanation of contributor highlighting.

interview.narrativePedigree.showingCondi.description: Live announcement after selecting a condition. condition is its unchanged protocol-authored name.

interview.narrativePedigree.showingFocus.defaultMessage: Showing {condition}. Focused on {name}. Showing who contributes to their inheritance.
interview.narrativePedigree.showingFocus.description: Whole live announcement naming the selected condition and focused person, then explaining the inheritance-contributor highlight. condition and name remain separate, unchanged values.

interview.narrativePedigree.snapshotCond.description: Whole snapshot heading combining the authored stage title and condition name. title and condition remain verbatim; the punctuation can follow locale conventions.

interview.narrativePedigree.snapshotInhe.description: Whole snapshot heading for a condition focused on a person. title and condition are authored text; name is entered text or a localized fallback. Translate only the surrounding inheritance phrase.

interview.narrativePedigree.sourceMissin.defaultMessage: This stage references a family pedigree that could not be found.
interview.narrativePedigree.sourceMissin.description: Empty-state error when the protocol references a family-tree source that cannot be found. Uses participant language rather than exposing the internal stage identifier.

interview.narrativePedigree.statusUnknow.description: Clinical status tooltip and screen-reader label when the inheritance information does not establish a displayed genetic status.

interview.narrativePedigree.symbols.description: Subheading explaining the visual genetic-status glyphs, including uncertain statuses only when enabled by the protocol.

interview.narrativePedigree.viewportCont.description: Accessible group name for controls that reset the diagram view rather than change family data.

interview.narrativePedigree.willDevelop.description: Plain-language legend meaning of the obligate/presymptomatic affected symbol: development is modelled as certain, unlike the may-develop status.

interview.narrativePedigree.zoomControls.description: Accessible name for the toolbar or button group that enlarges and reduces the family-tree view.

interview.narrativePedigree.zoomIn.description: Accessible action increasing the diagram magnification while preserving the view centre.

interview.narrativePedigree.zoomOut.description: Accessible action reducing the diagram magnification while preserving the view centre.

interview.navigation.automaticLanguage.description: Language option that follows the host's requested interface language.

interview.navigation.currentTextSize.description: Screen-reader announcement after the participant changes text size; size is a multiplier.

interview.navigation.decreaseTextSize.description: Accessible action that decreases interview text size.

interview.navigation.exitInterview.description: Action to leave an unfinished interview while preserving answers.

interview.navigation.exitInterviewDescri.defaultMessage: Your answers so far will be saved and you can continue later.
interview.navigation.exitInterviewDescri.description: Reassures the participant that exiting preserves their answers for resuming.

interview.navigation.exitInterviewTitle.description: Confirmation title before leaving an unfinished interview.

interview.navigation.exitReview.description: Action to leave the temporary interview review.

interview.navigation.exitReviewDescripti.defaultMessage: Changes made during this review will not be saved.
interview.navigation.exitReviewDescripti.description: Explains the temporary nature of answers changed in review mode.

interview.navigation.exitReviewTitle.description: Confirmation title before leaving an interview review.

interview.navigation.goToScreen.description: Accessible name for opening the interview screen navigation drawer.

interview.navigation.hiddenScreen.defaultMessage: This screen is hidden based on the answers given so far. Do you want to show it anyway?
interview.navigation.hiddenScreen.description: Explains why an interview screen is hidden before overriding that navigation rule.

interview.navigation.increaseTextSize.description: Accessible action that increases interview text size.

interview.navigation.interfaceLanguage.description: Label for the language of the interview package's built-in controls; protocol text is separate.

interview.navigation.interviewSettings.description: Accessible name of the settings popover inside a running interview.

interview.navigation.nextStep.description: Accessible name of the arrow that moves to the next interview screen.

interview.navigation.outsidePath.defaultMessage: This screen is outside the current interview path based on the answers given so far. Do you want to show it anyway?
interview.navigation.outsidePath.description: Explains that a screen is outside the current answer-dependent path before opening it.

interview.navigation.previousStep.description: Accessible name of the arrow that moves to the previous interview screen.

interview.navigation.settings.description: Accessible name of the interview settings button.

interview.navigation.showScreen.description: Action that opens an otherwise unavailable interview screen.

interview.navigation.showTitle.description: Confirmation title before opening an interview screen hidden by earlier answers.

interview.navigation.textSize.description: Legend for the text-size input; hidden adds the percentage unit for screen readers.

interview.runtime.addPerson.description: Accessible action that adds a person to the current interview task.

interview.runtime.canvas.description: Announced name of the area where items can be positioned.

interview.runtime.collapseDrawer.description: Accessible action that folds the item tray closed.

interview.runtime.copied.description: Confirmation that interview diagnostic information was copied.

interview.runtime.copyClipboard.description: Tooltip for copying diagnostic information about an interview error.

interview.runtime.copyDebugInfo.description: Button that copies interview error details for the study organizer.

interview.runtime.decryptFailed.defaultMessage: There was an error decrypting the data with the passphrase entered. Please try again.
interview.runtime.decryptFailed.description: Error after the entered passphrase could not decrypt the data.

interview.runtime.decryptRetry.defaultMessage: There was a problem decrypting the data. Please re-enter your passphrase.
interview.runtime.decryptRetry.description: Message asking for another passphrase after decryption fails.

interview.runtime.deleteBin.description: Announced name of the drop target that deletes an item.

interview.runtime.drawer.description: Announced name of the tray containing items that can be placed.

interview.runtime.dropToRemove.description: Hint shown on the tray when dropping an item removes its position.

interview.runtime.enterPassphrase.description: Title of the dialog for revealing encrypted interview data.

interview.runtime.expandDrawer.description: Accessible action that expands the item tray.

interview.runtime.filter.description: Placeholder for filtering the interview screen navigation list.

interview.runtime.finishConfirmationDesc.defaultMessage: Finish this interview only when you are satisfied with your responses.
interview.runtime.finishConfirmationDesc.description: Default finish confirmation; the host may supply its own context-specific explanation.

interview.runtime.finishFailed.defaultMessage: The interview could not be finished. Please try again. If the problem continues, contact the study organizer.
interview.runtime.finishFailed.description: Recoverable finish-dialog error after saving pending answers or the host finish request fails; no claim is made that all responses have been submitted.

interview.runtime.firstNode.description: Fallback accessible name for the first item when its name is missing.

interview.runtime.hiddenByAnswers.description: Status on a screen unavailable because of answers given so far.

interview.runtime.interviewScreens.description: Accessible name of the interview screen navigation list.

interview.runtime.itemUnavailable.defaultMessage: This item could not be displayed.
interview.runtime.itemUnavailable.description: Fallback when protocol-provided media cannot be displayed.

interview.runtime.loadingVideo.description: Status while a protocol-provided video is loading.

interview.runtime.minimumItems.defaultMessage: You must create at least {count, number} {count, plural, one {item} other {items}} before you can continue.
interview.runtime.minimumItems.description: Blocking message when too few items have been created; emphasize the minimum count.

interview.runtime.noSearchMatch.description: Empty result after searching the interview screen list.

interview.runtime.nodeList.description: Accessible name for a list of people or other items.

interview.runtime.notifications.description: Accessible name of the interview notification region.

interview.runtime.offlineMap.defaultMessage: You are offline — the map will not load until you reconnect.
interview.runtime.offlineMap.description: Persistent message while a map screen cannot load offline.

interview.runtime.offlineTaskDescription.defaultMessage: You appear to be offline, and this task could not be displayed. Some tasks (such as maps) need a connection. Check your connection and refresh the page. You may be able to continue by selecting the next arrow. If the problem persists once you are back online, please contact the study organizer and provide the debug information below.
interview.runtime.offlineTaskDescription.description: Recovery instructions when an interview task cannot be displayed without a network connection.

interview.runtime.offlineTaskTitle.defaultMessage: This task needs an internet connection
interview.runtime.offlineTaskTitle.description: Error heading when an interview task cannot run offline.

interview.runtime.outsideCurrentPath.description: Status on a screen outside the currently selected interview path.

interview.runtime.passphrase.description: Label of the secret phrase input used to decrypt interview data.

interview.runtime.passphraseHelp.defaultMessage: Enter your passphrase in order to unlock the data on this screen. If you cannot remember your passphrase, please contact the person who recruited you to this study.
interview.runtime.passphraseHelp.description: Instructions for unlocking encrypted data and finding help if the passphrase is forgotten.

interview.runtime.passphraseNeeded.defaultMessage: Your passphrase is needed to show data on this screen. Click here to enter it.
interview.runtime.passphraseNeeded.description: Explains why a passphrase is needed to reveal data on the current screen.

interview.runtime.passphrasePlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the interview decryption passphrase input.

interview.runtime.secondNode.description: Fallback accessible name for the second item when its name is missing.

interview.runtime.submissionFailed.defaultMessage: An error occurred while submitting the form.
interview.runtime.submissionFailed.description: Generic form error when no submit handler exists or it throws unexpectedly.

interview.runtime.submitPassphrase.description: Action that submits a passphrase to decrypt interview data.

interview.runtime.taskComplete.defaultMessage: You have completed this task. Click the next arrow to continue.
interview.runtime.taskComplete.description: Notification that the maximum item count is reached and the participant can continue.

interview.runtime.taskErrorDescription.defaultMessage: There was an error with the interview software, and this task could not be displayed. Try refreshing the page. If the problem persists, please contact the study organizer and provide the debug information below. You may be able to continue your interview by clicking the next button.
interview.runtime.taskErrorDescription.description: Recovery instructions for an unexpected interview screen failure.

interview.runtime.taskErrorTitle.description: Heading when an interview screen cannot be rendered.

interview.runtime.unnamedRosterItem.description: Fallback label for an external-roster item with no usable name; subject is protocol-authored and number is a stable position.

interview.runtime.unplacedCount.description: Number of items in the tray that have not yet been placed on the canvas.

interview.runtime.untitledStage.description: Fallback for an interview screen with no authored label.

interview.runtime.videoUnavailable.description: Error when a protocol-provided video cannot load.
